events.summary: 1,000 wishlists! 🖤 Thank you to every player, every streamer, and everyone who took the time to check out my game. Thank you for your trust and support. It means the world to me. Sending hugs to each and every one of you!

events.title: Streamer Update: Music Fixed
events.summary: We've identified an issue where YouTube is flagging and muting a track used in the Present Day level - despite it being free-to-use music, properly licensed with creator attribution. Unfortunately, YouTube's Content ID system sometimes misidentifies legitimately licensed tracks as copyrighted content, regardless of permissions.To keep streamers and content creators safe from unwanted claims or mutes, we've added Streamer Mode to the options menu. Enabling it automatically swaps the flagged track

events.title: The 23 Days demo is now live on Steam!
events.summary: Hello! Friends, today's a big day - the demo for 23 Days is available on Steam right now! You can dive into the game's atmosphere, get a feel for its mechanics, and form your own impression before the full release. What to expect in the demo: - The beginning of the story and an introduction to the key characters - The core gameplay - The atmosphere and visual style of the game Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist - it's the best way to support us. events.title: A Moment from Day 12 – The Radio Reacts | 23 Days
events.summary: Hola! Sometimes you get those amazing moments when inspiration suddenly hits, and in a single day you create everything you've been planning for months. Here's a small moment from Day 12, one of my favorite scenes in the game. Throughout this entire level, the radio will react to and comment on your actions. Hugs to you all!
